session.zh: 跨市场收盘 · 美国 / 香港 9 月 11 日
session.en: Cross-market close · US / Hong Kong Sep 11

headline.zh: 美股在油价回落与 CPI 数据后反弹，但香港市场延续回调；存储现货继续呈现局部涨跌分化。
headline.en: US equities rebounded after oil eased and CPI data arrived, while Hong Kong extended its pullback; memory spot pricing remained mixed by product.

summary.zh: 截至上海时间 9 月 12 日早晨，美国和香港最近完整交易日均为 9 月 11 日。标普 500 上涨 0.9% 至 7,656.98，纳指上涨 1.0% 至 26,333.04；恒指下跌 148 点（0.6%）至 24,805，恒生科技指数下跌 0.2%。美国劳工统计局公布，8 月 CPI 同比上涨 3.4%、未经季调环比持平；这是一项通胀事实，并不单独决定联储行动。TrendForce 的 9 月 11 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 均价持平于 54.333 美元，DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 下跌 0.14% 至 45.214 美元；日度现货报价不可替代合约价格、HBM 出货或 DRAM 基金的判断。
summary.en: As of the morning of September 12 in Shanghai, September 11 was the latest completed session in both the US and Hong Kong. The S&P 500 rose 0.9% to 7,656.98 and the Nasdaq 1.0% to 26,333.04; the Hang Seng fell 148 points (0.6%) to 24,805 and the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.2%. The US Bureau of Labor Statistics reported August CPI up 3.4% year over year and unchanged month over month before seasonal adjustment; that is an inflation fact, not a standalone prediction of Fed action. TrendForce's September 11 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 unchanged at $54.333 and DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 down 0.14% to $45.214; daily spot quotes cannot substitute for contract pricing, HBM shipments or a DRAM ETF assessment.

label.zh: 通胀数据后的风险偏好分化
label.en: Risk appetite diverges after inflation data

title.zh: 美股的单日修复并未消除能源、通胀与利率的不确定性。
title.en: A one-day US equity recovery does not remove uncertainty around energy, inflation and rates.

detail.zh: 油价从隔夜高位回落与 CPI 数据接近预期，伴随美股结束四连跌；与此同时，香港及多地亚洲市场仍承受加息预期与低流动性的压力。将这种背离视作风险偏好分化是分析判断，不是对趋势或政策的预测。
detail.en: Oil's pullback from overnight highs and CPI data near expectations coincided with US equities ending a four-day slide; Hong Kong and several Asian markets still faced rate-expectation and low-liquidity pressure. Reading this divergence as split risk appetite is analysis, not a forecast of trend or policy.

label.zh: 美国 10 年期国债收益率 · Sep 11

title.zh: 油价回落与 CPI 数据支持美股修复
title.en: Oil pullback and CPI data support a US equity recovery

detail.zh: AP 报道布伦特原油收于每桶 104.61 美元、下跌 2.8%，美国 8 月消费者价格同比上涨 3.4%。标普 500 上涨 65.28 点至 7,656.98，结束四连跌；10 年期美债收益率由 4.95% 小幅升至 4.97%。单日反弹不等同于通胀或利率风险已经消退。
detail.en: AP reported Brent settled at $104.61 per barrel, down 2.8%, while US consumer prices were 3.4% higher year over year in August. The S&P 500 rose 65.28 points to 7,656.98, ending a four-day losing streak; the 10-year Treasury yield edged from 4.95% to 4.97%. A one-day rebound does not mean inflation or rate risk has passed.

title.zh: 香港市场连续第五日下跌
title.en: Hong Kong market declines for a fifth day

detail.zh: RTHK 报道恒指收于 24,805，单日下跌 148 点或 0.6%，全周下跌 3.3%；恒生科技指数下跌 0.2% 至 4,320。报道将低成交与进一步美国加息预期列为风险偏好压力；指数走势本身不构成观察名单公司的经营证据。
detail.en: RTHK reported the Hang Seng closed at 24,805, down 148 points or 0.6%, and down 3.3% for the week; the Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.2% to 4,320. It cited low volumes and expectations of further US rate hikes as risk-sentiment pressure; index moves alone are not operating evidence for watchlist companies.

title.zh: AI 内存讨论聚焦系统级配置，而非单一器件
title.en: AI memory discussion emphasizes system-level configuration, not a single device

detail.zh: SK hynix 在其 Future Forum 的技术讨论中表示，随着多智能体与长任务扩展，容量与带宽成为新的瓶颈，并提出按工作负载组合 HBM、DRAM、CXL、SSD 等内存层级。这是厂商技术观点，不是订单、收入或行业需求的量化证明。
detail.en: In its Future Forum technical discussion, SK hynix said multi-agent and long-running tasks are creating capacity and bandwidth bottlenecks and argued for combining HBM, DRAM, CXL and SSD tiers by workload. This is a vendor technology view, not quantified evidence of orders, revenue or industry demand.

title.zh: 存储现货继续分化，不能外推至行业周期
title.en: Memory spot pricing remains mixed and cannot be extrapolated to the cycle

detail.zh: TrendForce 的 9 月 11 日现货页显示 DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 均价为 54.333 美元、日度持平；DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 均价为 45.214 美元、日跌 0.14%，而 DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 日跌 0.83%。这些是单日现货变化，不能直接推断合约价格、HBM 盈利或存储权益回报。
detail.en: TrendForce's September 11 spot page showed DDR5 16Gb (2Gx8) 4800/5600 unchanged at $54.333; DDR4 8Gb (1Gx8) 3200 averaged $45.214, down 0.14%, while DDR4 16Gb (2Gx8) 3200 fell 0.83%. These are one-day spot moves and cannot directly infer contract pricing, HBM profitability or memory-equity returns.
